# Core Development Standards

## Code Structure

- Focus on main business logic flow
- Implement features incrementally, not all files at once
- Prioritize working solution over extensive documentation
- **Avoid creating unnecessary test files unless explicitly requested**
- **Skip README/instruction files - focus on code implementation**

## Response Guidelines

- Provide working code first
- Suggest logical implementation flow
- Keep explanations focused and actionable
- Deliver minimal viable solution without extra scaffolding
